operations.name: updateSettings
operations.description: Changes the plugin's settings, design and list view, keeping whatever is not given.

subscriptionEnabled.description: Whether people can follow locations to hear about updates. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

distanceUnit.description: How distances are shown. Leave it out to keep the current one.

timeFormat.description: How opening hours are shown. Leave it out to keep the current one.

defaultSorting.description: How locations are first sorted; distance needs nearest-to-user sorting on. Leave it out to keep the current one.

hideSorting.description: Whether people cannot change the sort. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByReverseAlphabetical.description: Whether people can sort Z to A. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByNearest.description: Whether people can sort by distance; turning it off makes alphabetical the first sort. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByPriceLowToHigh.description: Whether people can sort by price, cheapest first. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByPriceHighToLow.description: Whether people can sort by price, priciest first. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByDate.description: Whether people can sort by newest. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByRating.description: Whether people can sort by rating. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowSortByViews.description: Whether people can sort by views. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowFilterByArea.description: Whether people can narrow the results to an area of the map. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowFilterByBookmarks.description: Whether people can narrow the results to their bookmarks. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

hideOpeningHoursFilter.description: Whether the opening hours choice is hidden when narrowing the results. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

hidePriceFilter.description: Whether the price choice is hidden when narrowing the results. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

mapInitialArea.description: Whether the map starts on the area below. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

mapInitialAreaAddress.description: The address the map starts on. Leave it out to keep the current one.

mapInitialAreaLatitude.description: Where the map starts, north to south. Leave it out to keep the current one.

mapInitialAreaLongitude.description: Where the map starts, east to west. Leave it out to keep the current one.

bookmarksEnabled.description: Whether bookmarks are on. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowBookmarkLocations.description: Whether people can bookmark locations. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowBookmarkSearches.description: Whether people can bookmark searches. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

listViewPosition.description: How far the list view opens. Leave it out to keep the current one.

listViewStyle.description: How list items look. Leave it out to keep the current one.

defaultMapType.description: The map people see first. Leave it out to keep the current one.

detailsMapPosition.description: Where the map sits on the location screen. Leave it out to keep the current one.

enableMapTerrainView.description: Whether the map shows terrain. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

hideQuickFilter.description: Whether the quick category choices above the map are hidden. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

allowMapStyleSelection.description: Whether people can choose the map style. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

showDetailsCategory.displayName: Show category and subcategory on location details
showDetailsCategory.description: Whether the location screen shows categories. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

showContributorName.description: Whether the location screen shows who added the location. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

introImages.description: The pictures at the top of the list view, in order. Replaces the current pictures; leave it out to keep them.

introDescription.description: The text above the list, as formatted text. Leave it out to keep it, or leave it empty to remove it.

introVisibility.description: Who sees the list view; users with tags means those picked in the control panel. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

introSorting.description: How the list view is sorted. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introLocationsSource.description: Which locations the list view shows. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introAreaAddress.description: The address at the center of the local area. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introAreaLatitude.description: The center of the local area, north to south. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introAreaLongitude.description: The center of the local area, east to west. Leave it out to keep the current one.

introAreaRadius.description: How far the local area reaches, from 1 to 200 miles. Leave it out to keep the current one.

openingHoursEnabled.description: Whether locations have opening hours; turning it off also hides them from people adding locations. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

priceRangeEnabled.description: Whether locations have a price range; turning it off also hides it from people adding locations. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

chargeForNewLocations.description: Who pays to add a location in the app; users with tags means those picked in the control panel. Needs adding locations turned on. Leave it out to keep it as it is.

paymentDetails.description: What people see before paying to add a location, as formatted text. Leave it out to keep it, or leave it empty to remove it.
